title: OPINION (BNB) L-06 dispute-timeout + Tenbin Labs (Ethereum) Zellic 3.2/3.3 — live unprivileged extraction assessment
closed_reasons: OPINION: timeoutDispute(bytes32) is onlyRole(OPERATOR_ROLE); unprivileged eth_call reverts AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount and the fork test confirms it.

OPINION: resolve(bytes32,uint256[]) is gated to the ResolutionMultiSig contract 0x95eea6b2a441dd720177ddd365a113f8b4129e91 (storage-override eth_call returns 0xfff7d58e(caller,0x95ee...)); the disputor cannot self-resolve.
OPINION: the 72 x 1000 OPN reward pool ($2,621.00) is only reachable after a privileged timeout; observed 0/61 timeouts, break-even probability 50%, EV at the 95% upper bound is -$32.82/dispute.
OPINION: the $2.753M CTF USDT collateral is not in the DisputeResolver and is not moved by L-06.
Tenbin 3.2: RevenueModule.collect() is onlyRole(REVENUE_KEEPER_ROLE) and CollateralManager.withdrawRevenue() is onlyRevenueModule; both revert for an unprivileged caller.
Tenbin 3.2: the keeper is a protocol EOA; current realizable P-value is min(getRevenue,liquid) = $23.28 (tGLD 9.94 + tMXN 13.34; tBRL has 0 liquid).
Tenbin 3.3: the audited MorphoVaultV1Adapter is not deployed in the live parent vaults; the live funded adapter is GenericMorphoAdapter targeting Steakhouse Prime USDC.
Tenbin 3.3: Steakhouse Prime USDC has $139.17M TVL; zeroing a $447k allocation needs $5.99e31 of donation, and a $1M donation only dilutes 71 bps.

poc.note: Earlier run 42734829660 failed only because CI BSC_RPC_URL was set-but-empty; the fallback was fixed and the suite re-ran 9/9 green.

key_facts: OPINION production addresses were recovered from the app.opinion.trade Next.js bundle (BSC_MAINNET stage) and cross-checked against DefiLlama's sumTokens owner 0xAD1a38cEc043e70E83a3eC30443dB285ED10D774 (ConditionalTokens).
OPINION v5 auto resolver 0xE19B...64A4 (VERSION 5.0.0) holds 72,000 OPN ($2,621.00) and 72 active Pending questions; v4 committee resolver 0x5E09...5985 is idle with 2,000 OPN ($72.81).
timeoutDispute on both resolvers reverts AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount for 0x1111..., role 0x97667070...b929 (OPERATOR_ROLE); holder is EOA 0xBE39...c14e (nonce 130,241).

Storage-override eth_call on a Disputed resolution: resolve() returns 0xfff7d58e(caller, 0x95eea6b2a441dd720177ddd365a113f8b4129e91) for the attacker/disputor, a random EOA and the operator EOA; 0x95ee... is a custom ResolutionMultiSig (VERSION 1.3.0, proposals(uint256), admin 0x074A...2655).
OPINION L-06 net to a successful disputor is +1,000 OPN ($36.40) per question (claim pays 2x the 1,000 OPN stake); the CTF holds 2,753,274.36 USDT ($2.753M) but is not in the resolver.
Observed 63 ResolutionReceived, 61 ResolutionFinalized, 63 RewardDeposited, 0 DisputeFiled, 0 DisputeTimedOut, 0 StakeClaimed in 132,650,000..132,685,435.
Tenbin TVL is $1,345,792.27 USDC across tBRL/tGLD/tMXN; all three CollateralManager implementations are verified and match the audited 3.2 _getRevenue/withdrawRevenue code.
Tenbin unrealized revenue is $35.93; liquid USDC is $203.63; min(revenue,liquid) = $23.28; the modules already hold $919.88 of collected USDC.
Tenbin collect() reverts AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount(..., 0x42877691...a4f5) for an unprivileged caller; withdrawRevenue() reverts OnlyRevenueModule; the revenue keeper is an EOA (code size 0).

Tenbin's live funded adapter is GenericMorphoAdapter targeting Steakhouse Prime USDC (0xbeef0880...0f51, $139.17M TVL); none of the 12 live adapters exposes morphoVaultV1(); the audited MorphoVaultV1Adapter is absent.
Inflation math: zeroing a $447,127 allocation would require totalAssets > 5.988e37 raw USDC ($5.99e31); a $1M donation dilutes the next allocation by 71 bps.
caveats: OPINION v5 implementation source is unverified; resolve() auth and timeoutDispute gating were established from ABI/selectors, eth_call revert payloads, a storage-override probe and a fork test, not from source.
The OPINION committee's off-chain re-vote cadence and the operator EOA's automation are not public; timeout probability is estimated from ~4 hours of events (0/61), 95% upper bound ~4.9%.
OPINION's OPN price is a DefiLlama spot price ($0.036402718); thin liquidity could lower the realized USD reward but does not create an unprivileged path.
Tenbin's parent-vault allocator (dev multisig 0x48Fa008bD2660974d55Ee9b7A9ECA1cE61347614) can change adapter targets; a future unsafe ERC-4626 target would reopen 3.3 as an admin-conditioned path.
Tenbin TVL is the on-chain USDC collateral only; the protocol also describes an off-chain futures hedge leg, which is outside this on-chain assessment.
No mainnet transaction was sent; all exploit/value-transfer demonstrations ran on ephemeral forks in GitHub Actions.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live: OPINION L-06 needs the OPERATOR_ROLE EOA to time out a dispute after the committee fails (conditional $2,621, negative EV), and Tenbin 3.2 is keeper-gated while 3.3's audited adapter is not deployed and its live Steakhouse target ($139M TVL) is inflation-infeasible (P $23.28).
